mechanism_claims.claim_text: D(KLAKLAK)2 shows direct antifungal membrane activity against Mucorales in vitro, with germination inhibition, hyphal damage, dye uptake, and ATP release supporting membrane disruption/depolarization.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: D(KLAKLAK)2 all-D peptidomimetic motif in Mucorales isolates
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vitro Mucorales activity; no in vivo efficacy or toxicity endpoint is established by this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: D(KLAKLAK)2 treatment is associated with vacuolar injury, mitochondrial swelling, intracellular ROS accumulation, and mitochondrial membrane depolarization in the source assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is source-supported for the tested fungal cells and conditions, not generalized to untested organisms or in vivo infection.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports a mitochondria-mediated apoptosis mechanism through cytochrome c release, metacaspase activation, and NAC rescue of apoptotic features.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: R. oryzae and M. circinelloides germlings treated with D(KLAKLAK)2
mechanism_claims.limitations: Apoptosis mechanism is retained as an in vitro paper-specific finding; AMB comparison remains mechanistically unresolved by the authors.
